note: V0.1 research artifacts are immutable. This file adds calibration analysis only. No price approved.

architecture_decision.conclusion: Bricolage requires a THREE-LAYER architecture, not a single pricing model.

layers.name: Minimum Visit Price
layers.purpose: Guarantees economic viability for any standalone call-out. Travel + setup + basic task included. Prevents sub-floor pricing.
layers.note: All per-item prices for standalone visits must be at or above this floor.

layers.name: Per-Item Standardized Prices
layers.purpose: Clear, client-friendly prices for predictable bounded tasks. Absorbs minimum visit when single task.
layers.note: When one standardized task is booked standalone, its price must >= minimum visit price.

layers.name: Multi-Task Economics
layers.purpose: Additional tasks in same visit priced at reduced incremental rate — travel already paid.
layers.note: Half-day or first+additional architecture resolves multi-task visit fairness.

architecture_decision.anti_double_charge_principle: A client booking a single TV mount (BRIC-030 at 300 MAD) must NOT additionally pay a minimum visit fee (BRIC-001). The task price already includes travel. Minimum visit applies ONLY to micro-tasks with no associated standardized task price.

material_hardware_policy.disclosure_protocol: IDENTIFY item → STATE specification → STATE unit cost → CONFIRM quantity → CLIENT APPROVAL → PROCEED. Never buy and charge back without prior approval.

substrates: Mur porteur (structural wall — drilling or modification)
SPECIALIST_REQUIRED.action: REFUSE — MAÇONNERIE or structural engineer required

ELECTRICITE.rule: ANY work involving electrical circuit conductors, wiring connections, outlet or switch replacement, luminaire wiring, electrical socket relocation — routes to ELECTRICITE without exception.
ELECTRICITE.key_escape_condition: Cable concealment requiring electrical socket move during TV installation

PLOMBERIE.rule: Any pipe modification, hot water system, drainage change — PLOMBERIE. Minor consumer maintenance (tap washer, siphon) — CONDITIONAL FIXEO decision deferred.
PLOMBERIE.note: FIXEO has not yet approved minor plumbing as bricolage scope. Default to PLOMBERIE until explicit human decision.

SERRURERIE.rule: Lock cylinder, security mechanism, entrance door lock — SERRURERIE. Interior non-security door handle — BRICOLAGE_ALLOWED.
SERRURERIE.key_distinction: Interior lever handle on bedroom/bathroom door = bricolage. Porte palière / porte blindée = serrurerie always.

MENUISERIE.rule: Custom fabrication, structural wood — MENUISERIE. Adjustment of existing hardware (hinge, handle) on interior door — BRICOLAGE_ALLOWED.

MACONNERIE.rule: Load-bearing wall — MAÇONNERIE. Anchor-size drilling in non-structural wall — BRICOLAGE_ALLOWED.

CARRELAGE.rule: Tile laying, replacement, grouting — CARRELAGE always.

VITRERIE.rule: Glass modification, window glass — VITRERIE always.
